top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs a quantitative prediction (flat bands at a magic twist angle, MacDonald and Bistritzer) with the experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states (Jarillo-Herrero), reproduced by many independent laboratories and carried to other moire platforms; the three-name allocation splits cleanly into theory and experiment, and the citation claims no pairing mechanism. The cost is a young field and truncated credit (Cao, earlier twisted-bilayer theory). P002 (optical lattice clocks, Katori and Ye) is the more mature and more cleanly attributed alternative and I rank it second without reluctance; an award is preferable to none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my documented collaborations (PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGOLite/PoGO+, XL-Calibur) do not touch moire materials or optical clocks
